open-address.description: Opens an address with its scheme, by its scheme's handlers in your order.

restart-mod.description: Restarts a mod, or launches one not running with the mods that require it.

restart-app.description: Quits the app and opens it again.

show-mods-folder.description: Shows the folder of the installed mods in Finder.

show-data-folder.description: Shows the folder where mods keep their data in Finder.

show-log.description: Shows the app's log in Finder.
